text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone on the south side of Trowell Avenue, between Kane Avenue and Silverthorn Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Trowell Avenue, between a point 53 metres west of Silverthorn Avenue and a point 11 metres further west.
